name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog
description: Destructive or irreversible actions that need confirmation.

motionProfile.reason: Alert Dialog owns its panel presence, measured message height, scoped paint and the title/description display; the composed action and cancel buttons keep Button's own press, paint, label and box owners, and Base UI keeps mounting, modality, focus and dismissal.

enter.pop/one-shot.reason: The panel owns one opacity and scale entrance envelope and the independent backdrop owns one stationary opacity entrance on its own rendered host.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: A closing panel and backdrop each fade on their own opacity channel while Base UI retains the native unmount, modality and focus protocol.
A composed action or cancel is an ordinary Button: its own retained exit is Button's, so the alert adds no second removal fade or pending decision.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The panel shell owns one clamped measured block-size transaction over its natural message while the alert is open and not closing.
A composed action keeps Button's own measured label/icon box and explicit size variants; the panel's block-size owner never rewrites a child button's box.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Content, media, title and description each own their declared scoped paint on their own physical region, with focus and unverified palettes immediate.
A composed action keeps Button's single surface and foreground owner, including its immediate focus/invalid priority and its light/dark variant boundary.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: A directly supplied plain Title or Description string replaces only its changed graphemes; rich children keep their native identity.
A composed action's label is Button's own changed-run owner; the alert installs no second text writer on the action label.

number.roll/reels.reason: A directly supplied supported numeric quantity in Title or Description rolls only its changed places; strings and codes remain text.
A composed action's numeric label is Button's own quantity owner; the alert does not parse or reel action labels itself.

feedback.press/one-shot.reason: The composed action and cancel buttons keep Button's own press layer, held/released state and immediate native activation; the alert adds no second executor or closing policy.
